notes.title: Cauldrons of War Stalingrad - The HQ Management patch
notes.notes:
CoW Stalingrad is evolving fast and some of its features will be added to CoW Barbarossa

[h2]You can now transfer ressources between your Army groups or Fronts.[/h2]

This may not succeed however :

Generals were constantly asking for reinforcements and those had to be taken from other Army groups whose general would fight not to let their assets go...

You can now too play this petty games.
Click on your Fronts or Army Groups : you will see a new HQ icon along your armies. This icon gives you access to new actions :
- Ask for more trucks
- Ask for more reserves
- Ask for more aircrafts

If playing as the Axis, you ma be offered the possibility to activate Army Group Crimea if it isn't active.

This new transfer feature has been playested in the previous days and seems to work fine. I hope you will enjoy it.

[h2]Other minor features[/h2]

-Turkey can now directly besiege Batumi
-Giant Pockets have been added to the western part of the Caucasus
-A new Axis event have been added in the case the Army Group Center destroys all the soviets units in Rhzev or Orel.
(Some of these features have been added since a week or two , but they are now well tested and debugged, so they make it to the "official patch")

[h2]Become a bug buster[/h2]

In the menu, I've added a "bug report" button : this feature will greatly facilitate my bug hunt.

Here is a list of some of the recently killed bugs:

-Some Buggy operations have been fixed : Narva, Kharkov, The Caucasus Giant Pockets
-You now really score points as the Soviet for taking Kharkov
-If you send aircrafts to "briefly" help Model, you won't lose them next turn.
-You no longer spend 2 Command points to fight partisans in cleaning operations.

Many other minor bugs have fallen, but I just keep track of the "Star Bugs".


[h2]The Stalingrad City Scenario[/h2]

Still in progress...
I am testing a lot of ideas... and discard a lot of them.
But I am starting to get satisfied.

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: Rostov Patch
notes.notes:
What's new in this patch?

[b]You can now attack toward Rostov from Kharkov[/b]
This is a huge change in gameplay. Rostov will be easier to take, but  doing so, the Army Group South may be burdened with too many operations. 

[b]As the Svir junction is accomplished, Finland HQ will be connected to southern operations[/b]
You will be able to use your clever winter proofed finnish troops in some new places now.  

[b]The 2nd german army is now splitable [/b]
Really, i don't know why it was not the case earlier...

Also in this patch : some minor text and bug fixes.

Now you have no excuses for not winning as the german !

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik



PS: What's next ?

I am working on the Cauldrons of War sequel "Cauldrons of War-Stalingrad".
This new game will include the operations from may 1942 to february 1943

Cool features i will code for that sequel will be retrofited in Cauldron of War Barbarossa if possible.

notes.title: October patch
notes.notes:
Hello there!

In the last patch :

-A rare but annoying bug in the soviet counter-strike in the Baltic is now corrected
-Typos corrected 
-A cheat code system have been added

Cheat codes :

-They don't work on multiplayer (of course)
-They can only be triggered from the map view
-They can only be triggered once per session
-They exist to help you explore deeper the game, more than to help you cheat

Type simultaneously "C" for cheat and :

-"P" to add 1 command point to each of your HQs
-"T" to add 100 trucks to each of your HQs
-"A" to add 10 planes to each of your HQs
-"R" to recon all ennemy units (this one is unlimited)

Have fun!

notes.title: Cauldrons of War official release september 25th
notes.notes:
Lead the operations on the eastern front at the highest strategical level.

Cauldrons of War is a simple but deep turn-based wargame about the invasion of USSR by nazi germany in 1941.

In this game, as the commander in chief, you won't  micro-manage lesser issues, but will focus on the great strategical affairs. The game stay tense, but you won't have to play 120 hours to finish a campaign, [u]and that alone will change your wargamer's life[/u].

This game features :

- 4 scenarios about the operations Barbarossa, Typhoon, the Moscow counter-offensive and the 1941-1942 soviet winter offensive

- A hot seat mod

- A PBEM mod

Have fun !

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: August quality of life patch
notes.notes:
This patch includes many awaited features :

[h3]Informations about event choices[/h3]
Multiple choices events now diplay informations bubbles about the consequences of the proposed choices. You won't be clicking randomly anymore.

[h3]You can now play "windowed"[/h3]
Access the windowed mode from the menu or simply by pressing the "w" key.

[h3]Soviet victory events in multiplayer[/h3]
The soviet events "AN IRANIAN JOURNEY" and "INDUSTRIAL RELOCATIONS" now can lower the german score in multiplayer (making it even harder for the german to win...)

[h3]Saved Games debuged[/h3]
At least... 
if you still encounter any bug on your save, just send me the data.dat file for debuging


[b]Next to come :[/b]

-The winter offensive full scenario


Have fun !

Maestro Cinetik

PS : I accept all player's defy via PBEM, just ping me on the Discord

notes.title: Patch of the day (May 28 2020)
notes.notes:
In today's patch :

- Joigning the Finns on the Svir now now let them join operations south of the river.
- As the Soviet player, you can now evacuate Tallin and Odessa by sea
- Some missing texts were added
- The game now keeps in memory your prefered settings for the map and for the sound
- Command points are now dispayed by default on the map
